title: InventoryFacetsRequest
description: Typed AAP request for the `inventory.facets` skill. An optional `filters` block scopes the facets to a subset of inventory (e.g. `condition: ['used']`). Shared by MCP tool arguments, A2A DataParts and native PAP OpenAPI bodies.

currency.description: Single currency of the matching set and price_range, without foreign-exchange conversion. When inventory.search is implemented, use its supported currencies and default_currency; an unsupported currency returns SCHEMA_VALIDATION_FAILED at /currency. Otherwise accept both USD and CAD and default to USD. A supported currency with no matching inventory returns empty facets.

mileage_unit.description: Unit of mileage_max and mileage_range. Both mi and km are supported. When inventory.search is implemented, use its default_mileage_unit; otherwise default to mi. Convert known odometers exactly using 1 mi = 1.609344 km without rounding before comparison or aggregation. Explicit _mi fields remain miles.

filters.description: Optional filters to scope facet aggregation. Same shape as inventory.search filters; all fields are optional.
